name: @wippy-session/wippy-form
title: Session Form
description: Renders a session ask_user form (single/multiple choice with Other) and submits the answer back to the owning session.

wippy.description: Renders one Session `ask_user` form artifact and submits the answer back to the owning session over the Host's artifact-state API. When every field in `definition` has `type: "choice"` (the only field type V1 emits), it renders a Claude-style question card: one question at a time for several-question forms, with a `‹ n/total ›` counter, per-answer notes, an Other free-text row, a review step before sending, and a read-only answered summary afterward. A mixed or non-choice definition falls back to a plain radio/checkbox fields form (kept for V2 standard fields). Inputs: `definition` (the immutable question/option data), `form-version` (schema version gate — an unsupported version disables submission), and `state` (the package-tag lifecycle: "active" while answerable, "idle" once answered). The component owns its own data loading (GET on mount, reload on visibility/session-message/artifact events), submission (request-id reuse, one automatic retry on a no-response network failure, 422 field-error and 409 already-submitted handling), and offline detection — the host only needs to mount the tag with these three attributes. Edge cases handled: a stale ("asked earlier") form, a race where another client answers first, a reload that fails while a view is already showing, and an unsupported form-version. Agents must never write the `<wippy-form>` tag themselves, because it is created only through the Session `ask_user` tool and never from agent-generated content.

form-version.description: Form definition schema version (currently 1). A value other than 1, from this prop or from the loaded state's own `form_version`, disables the interactive form and shows the notice "This form needs a newer version of the app." instead.

definition.description: Immutable form definition: `title`, optional `description`, optional `submit_label`, optional `answered_message` (not displayed), and `fields` (each `{ id, type: "choice", label, description?, required, options: [{value, label, description?}], multiple, allow_other }`). When every field is `type: "choice"` the question-card UI renders; otherwise the radio/checkbox fields form renders.

state.description: Package-tag lifecycle state mirrored from the artifact: "active" (still answerable) or "idle" (already answered, shown read-only). Changing this prop triggers a reload of the canonical form state from the Host.

density.description: Question-card sizing: "compact" (default) or "comfortable", a larger size/spacing scale. Read purely through the `:host([density="comfortable"])` CSS selector — no JS reads it — but must be a declared prop so the package-tag mount path can set it as an attribute.
